prompt: Add cursor pagination to GET /items in src/api.js. Query params: `limit` (integer 1 to 100, default 20) and `cursor` (opaque string from a previous response). The response body becomes { items, nextCursor } where nextCursor is null on the last page. Items are ordered by id ascending, and the cursor must stay correct if items are added or deleted between page requests (do not use offsets). The cursor must work together with the existing `tag` filter. An invalid limit or a malformed cursor returns the same error shape the other routes already use (status 400). Follow the patterns already in the code. Add tests in tests/. Run tests with `node --test`.
